photos.summary: Sheet pan of ~16 freshly baked rugelach crescents on parchment. Tops blonde and pale — not the deep golden brown the recipe describes — but bottoms visibly set and slightly darker at the edges (matches the note about bottoms setting before tops brown). Walnut-currant filling leaked from many of the crescents, pooling and caramelizing on the parchment between cookies. Shapes are inconsistent — some are tight tidy crescents, others are loose with visible filling exposed at the seam.

photos.summary: Two kraft paper bags with cellophane windows packed with finished rugelach, sitting on a dark wood table. Tartine cookbook visible in the background, partial title 'TINE' showing. Bagged for sharing or gifting after the bake.
